description: K₄Na₂TeO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.67-3.18 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.72-2.89 Å. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.75 Å. Te is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are two shorter (1.99 Å) and four longer (2.00 Å) Te-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four K, two equivalent Na, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four K, two equivalent Na, and one Te atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₄Na₂Te pentagonal bipyramids.
